text: NHK projects the LDP will secure roughly 274-328 of 465 Lower House seats, with the LDP-Japan Innovation Party coalition reaching as many as 366 seats. Before dissolution, the coalition effectively held only a one-seat working majority (230 seats plus three aligned independents). Opposition blocs (merged CDP-Komeito alliance) are projected to hold roughly 37-91 seats.

meta.note: Projections are early and not final certified results.
